description: A species with an entry in the bundle's rules.yaml. Every rules species has exactly one row; a code the rules do not name is refused.

t models the species; f pauses it: its rules and thresholds stay in the bundle, but it is not classified, adds no gradient breaks, and gets no access, habitat or mapping code. Exactly t or f; anything else is refused. A bundle that declares no file models every rules species.
Why the species is paused, and what would bring it back. Empty on a modelled row.
